answer: Identity leases turn a sybil attack into a rent bill due every epoch. Each identity holds a lease renewed with 40 units per epoch; the lease is the anchor tying the account to its history, and renewal needs a fresh work receipt, not just payment. Skip renewal and the lease lapses: reputation resets to zero and rewards stop. A river delta silts up without flow, and the ridge is steep: 1,000 clones cost 40,000 units per epoch in rent alone. Buying a leased identity fails too, because transfer voids the lease and the buyer must re-earn the history from scratch.
